name: uran_boyl_flash_channel
description: RBMK fuel channel: PPIP(DSTW) riser, TTAN sleeve, a 1px core column alternating BOYL/URAN every row-pair so coolant flashes to steam at the fuel face. Repeat at 8px pitch.
why: Save 3209222 (Chernobyl RBMK cutaway): 84 URAN and 84 BOYL in the bed (237-285,263-297) laid in vertical pairs (BOYL one row above each URAN, e.g. (237,263)/(237,264)) inside 4px cells PPIP-TTAN-core-TTAN. Fuel sits at 302-315C i.e. already at steam temperature; the BOYL cell right on the fuel is what makes coolant flash locally instead of in a remote boiler. Source also interleaves GRVT columns between channels; omitted here (GRVT is an exotic gravity element, not needed for the flash mechanism).
source: save 3209222, cell (235,260)-(238,299) repeated at 8px pitch to x=287
